messages:
Ellen (CS): Quick drop  I made a tiny 'Rapid Handoff Primer' for midsize customers — 90s checklist for CSMs: lightweight prefetch, client batching defaults, streaming safety-net + renewal flags. Pls quick review.

Dan (SE): paste the one-liner curl so CSMs can copy/paste.

Ellen (CS): safe curl (pasteable):
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-open-6b","prompt":"[rapid_handoff] prime","max_tokens":6}'
```

Dan (SE): client batching recs: web = 90ms OR 6 reqs; mobile = 160ms OR 7 reqs. Use route tag `interactive` for chat. Tiny JS snippet below.
```js
let q=[]; function enqueue(r){ q.push(r); if(q.length>=6) flush(); else setTimeout(flush,90); }
function flush(){ /* send batch */ q=[] }
```

Marco (SRE): Observability: emit `rapid.prefetch.attempt`, `rapid.prefetch.ok`, `rapid.batch.flush_count`, `rapid.stream.safety_fallback`. Tag with tenant_id, plan. Alert: prefetch.fail_rate >6% over 10m OR stream.fallback >2 in 15m. I'll add dashboard tiles.

Priya (PM): Renewal-risk signals for the healthcard: (1) prefetch failures >=3 in 48h, (2) stream safety fallback >2/day, (3) batch flush success drop >=20% W/W. If two conditions true -> flag yellow and schedule a 30m enablement.

Ellen (CS): Customer-facing fallback note (short):
"Hi — we're seeing streaming instability and have rerouted your workspace to a stable mode to keep responses reliable. No action needed; we'll update within 1 hour. Reply if you'd like a quick test command."

Marco (SRE): sample sanitized logs CSMs can request:
[2026-11-03T09:12:01Z] tenant=rapid prefetch=ok ttl=1200 backend=g2
[2026-11-03T09:12:02Z] tenant=rapid batch=flush size=6 latency_ms=105 route=interactive
[2026-11-03T09:14:20Z] tenant=rapid stream=safety_fallback reason=kv_miss count=1

Ellen (CS): I'll fold edits into the one-pager and send to the CSM list after Marco adds the dashboard. Thanks! :seedling:

alert-bot: Reminder: cs-sync at 15:00 UTC will include Rapid Handoff Primer review.
